designSummary: Nested case-control study with two controls per case matched on ventilation duration band and admission quarter; conditional logistic regression.
sampleSize: About 25 percent of about 300 eligible patients a year have weakness, so about 150 cases are expected from March 2025 to June 2027. With two controls per case and 40 percent of controls missing at least two eligible days, about 100 cases give 80 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05 to detect an odds ratio of 2.0, and about 140 cases an odds ratio of 1.8, before allowing for adjustment. The study is therefore sized for moderate associations only, and a null result will be reported with its interval.
primaryAnalysis: Conditional logistic regression of case status on missed eligible days, adjusted for severity score, deep sedation days, sepsis and corticosteroid use.
secondaryAnalysis: Difference in ICU days between cases and matched controls, described with a bootstrap interval and valued at the ICU day rate; area under the curve for the day-3 scale among patients who could be scored; missed days by day of week.
missingData: Days without documentation are analysed as a separate category and in a sensitivity analysis as missed; no imputation of case status.
multiplicity: One primary association; secondary analyses descriptive.
software: R (survival package for conditional logistic regression).
overfittingGuards: Four adjustment variables fixed in advance
No data-driven threshold for the day-3 scale
summary: About 150 cases and 300 controls; sized for odds ratios of about 1.8 or more.
